versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **ntriq-x402-blueprint** skill for architectural blueprint analysis.
- Extracts structured data (rooms, dimensions, areas, materials, structural elements) from floor plan images.
- Supports image input via URL or Base64 encoding.
- Flexible analysis types: full, dimensions only, rooms only, or materials only.
- Responses can be localized by specifying output language.
- Priced at $0.05 USDC per call, using x402 protocol on Base mainnet.
